It would also be nice to use a monospace font for the value, but we can't use outer `[code][/code]` since it prevents BBCodes from being escaped.
I don't really like that there are two tooltip options. In the future we should add tooltips for variable declarations too, but for now we can probably leave it as is.

We could do a more elegant way to cut off overly long values ​​than just truncate by the limit, something like [this](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/aa65940a8509fb880e2c666eb8a901525d9200ff/modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_docgen.cpp#L158). But it's not necessary to do that now, just fixing the bug is enough for now.

It's a nitpick, but I think something like this would look better:

```suggestion
			debug_value = debug_value.left(display_limit) + "... " + TTR("(truncated)");
```

Indeed, using a monospace font would be ideal. I tested with `[code][/code]` but the but is to big anyway. Also, having the possibility to copy to clipboard the value could be very handy. There's a lot that can be done to upgrade the debug tooltip but I will leave it to another PR.
